description: List the user's registered Argus agents (name, role, endpoint) and their free-tier state. ALWAYS call this first, before any run — it shows which agents exist and includes freeSimulation { used, limit, resetsAt } (MOCK simulation is FREE: rolling cap 25 runs / 24h, paid quota untouched). New accounts also hold 3 welcome engine runs (+30-run beta pack) for the real engine — visible in the console Billing page. If the target agent is missing, it must be registered in the Argus Console web UI first — tell the user; do not guess agent names or ids.
name: argus_list_agents
